description: Look up how research papers are cited. Scite reads the scientific literature and tells you whether each citation supports, contrasts or merely mentions the paper it cites. Get papers and their citation tallies by DOI, see where in citing papers a paper is cited, search the literature, check a journal's retractions and Scite Index, and look up authors. Papers and tallies work without an account; search, journals, authors and recommendations need a Scite API key (Scite Pro).
